questions.question: 3,2 kg of mealie meal and a 500 ml bottle, converted:
A chicken run 7 m by 4 m needs fencing and ground cover:
options: Perimeter 22 m of fencing, area 28 m² of ground — 2 × (7 + 4) and 7 × 4

questions.question: Drum: radius 0,6 m, height 1,2 m, pi as 3,142. Volume is:
options: 5,429 m³ — using the diameter by mistake

questions.question: That 1,357 m³ drum holds, in litres:
options: About 1 357 litres — one cubic metre is 1 000 litres

questions.question: 9 cm measured on a 1 : 25 000 hiking map is really:
options: 2,25 km — 225 000 cm walked down the unit ladder

questions.question: A 264 km trip at an average 80 km/h takes:
options: 3 hours 30 minutes — the decimal read as minutes

questions.question: A distance chart between towns is read by:
options: Adding the row and column totals
Running one town's row to the other's column — the crossing cell holds the kilometres

questions.question: On a cycle-race elevation chart, the steepest climb is where the line is:
options: Steepest — rising fastest, not sitting highest

questions.question: A wall measuring 88 mm on a 1 : 50 plan is really:
options: 4,4 m — 4 400 mm, and the 2-to-8-metre room check confirms it

questions.question: Heights of windows and roofs are found on:
options: The elevations — the floor plan cannot show UP

questions.question: The safe way to match an elevation to the floor plan:
options: Trust left and right as drawn
Pick the drawing with the most detail
Count the doors and windows the plan puts on each compass face and match the pattern — left and right flip outside

questions.question: An 8 m by 5 m library modelled at 1 : 40 measures 20 cm by 12,5 cm, and its roof area is:
options: One fortieth of the real area
One one-thousand-six-hundredth — areas shrink by the scale factor SQUARED

questions.question: The probability of landing on the one red sector of an eight-sector spinner, in three dialects:
A coin and a die together: the probability of a head with a six is:
options: 1/12 — list all twelve outcomes first: two faces times six numbers

questions.question: 60 learners; 21 girls and 18 boys walk. P(a randomly chosen learner walks):
A 40% chance of rain means the chance of NO rain is:
An 18 m by 8 m shed, with each trestle table needing 12 m², seats at 8 guests per table:
The bunting along the shed's edge needs:
options: 52 m — the perimeter, 2 × (18 + 8), because edging and covering are different jobs

questions.question: A 25 litre cooler pouring 200 ml cups serves 96 guests:
options: Yes — 25 000 ÷ 200 = 125 cups against 96 guests, with 29 spare

questions.question: 240 km at an average 80 km/h is:
For an 11:30 arrival with 3 hours of driving plus 45 minutes of stops, departure is:
options: 07:45 — subtract the driving to 08:30, then the stops

questions.question: The gravel road measures 7 cm on a 1 : 100 000 map. Its real length:
options: 7 km — 700 000 cm down the unit ladder

questions.question: The bakkie uses 9 litres per 100 km at R22,40 per litre. The 240 km trip costs:
A 40% chance of rain, written as a fraction and a decimal:
Rain fell on this weekend in 6 of the last 24 years. The experimental probability is:
What a 40% rain chance does NOT mean:
options: Rain is less likely than dry weather
On days like this, rain has arrived about 4 times in 10
That it will rain for 40% of the day or over 40% of the district

questions.question: A full-marks answer on hiring the R1 200 marquee:
options: Either choice, stated with its reason — weighing the marquee's cost against the cost of 96 soaked guests
